topic.title: Clarification on PubChem/COCONUT candidate-index redistribution
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: Can a private, offline CASMI 2026 submission notebook attach a candidate index derived from NCBI’s public PubChem Compound CID-SMILES.gz and CC0 COCONUT under the competition’s external-data and redistribution rules? The index contains standardized structures and computed search features. It excludes contributor annotations and competition training data. Is the PubChem bulk-file provenance sufficient, or do you require contributor-level clearance?
